import re
import sys

values = {}

pattern = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|-?\d+)\s*;")

for match in pattern.finditer(sys.stdin.read()):
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = int(source) if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", source) else values[source]

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
